note: Pilot B tempo map (LIB-11, DESIGN.md section 7; research claude/libht-research @ 38d5f9c6). Each card tempo array is built only from this file and that card plate.tempo: a row s is plate.tempo[from]; up is the concentric phase, down the eccentric, pause a Hold right after the concentric, present if and only if pause > 0. Moving rows are {phase, s, move: true}; Hold is {phase, s}. No constants, no Rest phase. crunch is held (no row).

push_up.why: the Mistake is the end pose plus an override (plate.mjs:78, :208): at the bottom the body is a hand's width off the floor, so sagging hips would pass through it; at the top the sag reads against the solid straight body, as pilot A's plank
